subject: english
question:
Some parts of one or more sentences have been jumbled up, and labelled A, B, C and D. Select the option that gives the correct sequence in which these parts can be rearranged to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence. Their approach sensitized

A. of it. Similarly, behind them, in the halls,

B. flicked on when they came within ten feet

C. a switch somewhere and the nursery light

D. lights went on and off as they left them behind, with a soft automaticity
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'CBAD'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct sequence** to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence is **CBAD.**
